snippet.title: Alex Gordon
snippet.description:
Get Alex Gordon: http://www.bigfishgames.com/download-games/3473/alex-gordon-game/index.html

Help Alex Gordon save his sister from the cunning Monkey King in this Platform Adventure game. Play through five glorious game worlds as you collect gold coins and stop the bad guys. Help Alex find pieces of the ancient amulet before it's too late!

  * Domestic Adventure game
  * Gorgeous game worlds
  * Rescue Alex Gordon`s sister
